────────────────────────────────────
NATURAL-LANGUAGE HYPOTHESIS (answer to the question)
────────────────────────────────────
During the Younger Bronze Age (YBA, 1100–500 BCE), the principal component value of PC1 at the beginning of the period (1100 BCE) is dramatically higher and of opposite sign from every subsequent 100-year horizon between 1000 and 500 BCE.

• Direction & sign. The canonicalised PC1 score at 1100 BCE is +5.35 (positive, large), while every other YBA slice has a negative PC1 score: -0.03 (1000 BCE), -0.26 (900 BCE), -0.14 (800 BCE), -0.96 (700 BCE), -1.86 (600 BCE) and -2.10 (500 BCE). All six contrasts therefore have a negative sign — 1100 BCE is unambiguously “on the positive side” of PC1, every later slice is on the negative side.

• Magnitude. Δ(t) = score(t) − score(1100 BCE) ranges from −5.38 (1000 BCE) to −7.45 (500 BCE), i.e. 1100 BCE lies ≈5–7½ PC1 units above the rest of the YBA region. The combined PC1+PC2 variance explained is 85.8 % (PC1: 62.5 %, PC2: 23.2 %), so PC1 captures a clearly one-dimensional “overall capital intensity” axis: PC1 has positive loadings on eight of the ten active forms of capital (Zhouse-size +0.39, Zdagger +0.39, Zmonument +0.38, ZCU/AU +0.37, Zambber +0.34, Zhort +0.30, Zhatchet/Sword +0.22, ZMW +0.14) and only negative loadings on Zbeil (−0.08) and Zkeverz (−0.38).

• Trend across 1000–500 BCE. After the high point at 1100 BCE, PC1 crashes by ~5.4 units already at 1000 BCE (essentially to the window's zero-line), wobbles slightly (small rebound at 800 BCE), then declines monotonically through 700, 600 and 500 BCE. In other words, relative to 1100 BCE, all subsequent YBA slices are below PC1, and the absolute level of PC1 trends downward towards the end of the Younger Bronze Age.

• Cross-validation. A companion PCA on the full 39 × 12 matrix (which keeps the constant ZSichel/ZKeform because they vary outside YBA) reproduces the same direction: aligned PC1 = +4.45 at 1100 BCE and falls through +2.15 (1000), +1.63 (900), +1.89 (800), +1.23 (700), +0.80 (600) and +0.78 (500). The 1100 BCE slice is the highest, 500 BCE the lowest, and the entire 1000–500 BCE block sits below 1100 BCE on PC1.

────────────────────────────────────
WORKFLOW EXECUTED
────────────────────────────────────
1. Loaded /workspace/data/capital.csv with the csv module, replacing German-locale decimal commas (",") inside quoted Z cells with "." so the 12 Z-value variables parse as floats. Dropped the metadata-flagged "group" and "color" columns.
2. Confirmed 39 rows on an exact 100-year BCE grid (500…4300); filtered to the Younger Bronze Age = 7 rows (1100, 1000, 900, 800, 700, 600, 500 BCE). Note: the question text says "13 Z values"; the file (and datasets.json) actually contain 12, so the analysis uses 12.
3. Within YBA, dropped ZSichel (≡0) and ZKeform (≡−1.13) which have zero variance and therefore cannot contribute to PCA in this window. The active PCA matrix is 7 × 10.
4. Standardised the 7 columns by their YBA sample mean and std (equivalent to using the correlation matrix; chosen because YBA-window per-column sd ranges from 0 (dropped) to 1.49 (ZHort), so a covariance PCA would be dominated by ZHort and ZCU_AU).
5. Ran SVD on the 7 × 10 standardised matrix (= fit PCA on the correlation matrix of the YBA subset). Report PC1 and PC2 eigenvalues and variance-explained ratios (62.5 % + 23.2 % = 85.8 %). Sign-canonicalised PC1 (and PC2) by requiring score(1100 BCE) > 0; report both raw and aligned scores.
6. Computed Δ(t) = aligned_PC1(t) − aligned_PC1(1100) for each t ∈ {1000, 900, 800, 700, 600, 500}, with sign, |Δ| and qualitative direction.
7. Optional companion: PCA on the full 39 × 12 matrix (no columns dropped) with PC1 sign aligned to the YBA-only fit at 1100 BCE. Reproduces the same direction with attenuated magnitudes (PC1 var = 30.3 %, PC2 = 19.5 %).

────────────────────────────────────
EVIDENCE / KEY NUMBERS
────────────────────────────────────
PC scores (YBA-only, sign-aligned so PC1(1100 BCE) > 0):
  1100 → +5.349     1000 → -0.026     900 → -0.258     800 → -0.138
  700  → -0.963     600  → -1.863     500 → -2.102

Δ vs 1100 BCE (aligned PC1):
  1000 → -5.376     900 → -5.607     800 → -5.487     700 → -6.312
  600  → -7.212     500 → -7.452

Full 39×12 PCA (cross-check, aligned PC1):
  1100 → +4.447     1000 → +2.148     900 → +1.627     800 → +1.894
  700  → +1.225     600  → +0.800     500 → +0.779

PC1 loadings (active 10 vars, aligned):
  ZAxtSchwert +0.217   ZDolch +0.385   Zhausgr +0.390   ZCU_AU +0.374
  Zamber    +0.337   ZMonument +0.377   ZHort +0.299   ZBeil -0.075
  ZMW       +0.140   Zkeverz -0.377
(8/10 positive ⇒ PC1 ≈ "overall capital intensity").
